articles.title: Michael Saylor hints at first bitcoin purchase in two months as bitcoin nears $79,000
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rebounds from Friday’s low as Strategy’s valuation expands and bitcoin dominance climbs above 60%.

articles.title: From Hawala to Swift: Inside the 1,000-year battle to move money safely
articles.snippet: Finance has spent centuries decoupling wealth from physical transport, but constantly erasing friction creates vectors for increasingly high-tech exploits.

articles.title: Inside the high-stakes battle between digital dollars and Swift's massive money engine
articles.snippet: Crypto executives say new blockchain payment infrastructure could make Swift obsolete. Bankers say its 11,500-institution network gives it the power to absorb the technology instead.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million worth of coins
articles.snippet: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.

articles.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
articles.snippet: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.
